observations.content: Assistant advised on OM parameters, concluding user only needs to change compactAtContextTokens alone since other params auto-balance; only raise pool pair 10k/15k to 15k/22k if om:status shows consolidate constantly near 15k.

Assistant's OM advice: keep chunkTokens at 10k, chunkOverlapTokens at 0, could raise tailTokens from 20k to 30k, keep observerConcurrency at 4, keep observer model deepseek medium, consolidator model MiniMax high with optional A/B test of glm-5.3 high.
compactAtContextTokens was just changed to 250k, which reduces frequency of hitting zombie bug #3845 (spinner stuck on mid-run resume); user's threshold changed from 150k to 250k.

Assistant diagnosed 5 structural flaws in the old OM report (L1 no action verdict, L2 raw runtime variables like lastCompactionObserverWait exposed, L3 cost not attributed to owner, L4 absolute numbers without percentage, L5 inconsistent naming topic files vs topics) and proposed 6 fixes for 5 flaws plus a new chunks pending line.
OM pipeline reported consolidator promote of 94 obs costing OM-$0.47 in the afternoon, viewed as abnormal cost but actually a normal large batch merge (led to L3 in report critique).
om timeline event: observer started ~9,210 tok; observer +13 observations ~9,210 tok, $0.4703 total across 43 runs.

Researcher subagent (id 1a574492-dedc-4700-bf4a-2cefd22bce11) finished and confirmed hypothesis: provider web search does NOT go through chat/completions but via each provider's own MCP server using the subscription key.

Z.ai GLM Coding Plan offers remote MCP Streamable HTTP at https://api.z.ai/api/mcp/web_search_prime/mcp, auth with the same Coding Plan API key, tool webSearchPrime; MCP calls count against plan's 5h/weekly quota as calls x 1.2 multiplier.

MiniMax Token Plan offers MCP package minimax-coding-plan-mcp via uvx (stdio), tools web_search and understand_image, auth MINIMAX_API_KEY with sk-cp- prefix, key and host must match region; web_search only works on Anthropic Messages API and OpenAI Responses API, not Chat Completions.
CLIProxyAPI has no MCP role; all 23 MCP issues on its repo are pass-through tool-name aliasing, client must connect to provider MCP server directly alongside using CLIProxyAPI as LLM gateway.
Assistant archived researcher agent 1a574492-dedc-4700-bf4a-2cefd22bce11 via paseo_archive_agent, succeeded.

Assistant proposed wiring Z.ai web search MCP into pi as MCP server so main agent and researcher role get webSearchPrime, needs user to supply the Z.ai API key; warned search calls eat quota at 1.2x so researcher should be limited by instruction.

User asked what the 6 OM report fixes would concretely do and recalled the OM commands as /om on off, status, compact, consolidation (assistant noted these as /om on|off, /om:status, /om:compact, /om:consolidate).

User decided to use the free tier (exa/jina) rather than wiring either provider MCP, since both MCP search options use quota; assistant closed the MCP wiring thread and kept exa+jina free tier as official search layer.

Assistant clarified there are three OM report surfaces: live timeline events (om: observer started etc., ephemeral, keep unchanged), and /om:status + om_status tool which share a duplicated builder in status.ts and status-tool.ts (the real target of the 6 fixes).

Assistant presented before/after mockups of /om:status with the 6 fixes: verdict first line, Workers section with chunks pending, Percent-context with warning at 80%, reworded topics (durable), cost split by role, and new costPerMTokRaw metric; plans to merge status.ts and status-tool.ts into one shared renderStatusLines builder.

User said the live timeline events (e.g. om: observer started +16 $0.25) are meaningless to them and wants them reworded to more meaningful values, and approved fixing the status report, asking assistant to implement then show the report.

Assistant decided to reword timeline lines: observer start/finish, consolidator start/done replacing promoted jargon, and compaction lines with percentages, keeping English self-explanatory wording (no bare + symbols).

Found timeline notify sites: observer-trigger.ts:101 start line and 181/187 finish lines with cumulative cost, consolidator-trigger.ts:94/96 start and 149-153 finish, compaction-trigger.ts:86/87 and 93/94.

Found recordWorkerCost in observer-trigger.ts:34 appends OM_COST entry with costUsd, role, runId; sumSessionCost in ledger/types.ts:158 sums cost and run count but not split by role, so per-role splitting requires summing ledger by role.

om_status tool in commands/status-tool.ts (59 lines) is read-only, model-facing, returns same numbers as /om:status without spawning workers, never appears in LLM context unless called; assistant needed to check its content before refactoring.
